title: How we share knowledge?
bodyHtml:
The Knowledge Portal Network Blog is dedicated to sharing scientific research, emerging insights, and perspectives from across disciplines. Our goal is to make complex ideas more accessible, meaningful, and relevant whether you’re a seasoned researcher, early in your career, or simply curious about the world. We highlight new discoveries, explore evolving trends, and provide a space for thoughtful commentary from voices within the research community.

 

The “bottom-line” associations: a scientific saga

Trang Nguyen

It’s been almost two centuries since Gregor Mendel gifted the world with his stories about the humble peas, and almost two decades since the first major genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of seven common diseases were published. Despite certain doubts about their utility, it is undeniable that GWAS provide valuable first clues in our search for disease culprits, as showcased by the guilty verdicts of NOD2 in Crohn’s disease and TCF7L2 in type 2 diabetes.
